result.summary: Mechanically adds `#include <util/check.h>` and removes redundant `<cassert>` includes across unit test, fuzz, and benchmark files that invoke `assert` or `Assert`. It also permits `clang-format` to run during scripted-diff verification and sorts modified test includes.
result.problem: Test files often rely on transitive includes or `<cassert>` for assertions, creating ambiguity about whether `NDEBUG` disables assertion checks. Incomplete includes also break builds when assertions are disabled in `util/check.h` and complicate running Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling.
evidence: Commit message: "The project has a compile error when compiled without assertions in util/check.h. Thus, util/check.h should be included for all assertions."
Description: "Avoid that confusion in test code with a scripted replacement to add the util/check.h include. The changes here will also make it easier to run IWYU."
result.scope_notes: Large mechanical scripted-diff modifying includes across more than 150 test files, alongside a minor CI linting configuration change.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; rebased onto current master.
result.card: This PR uses a scripted diff to add explicit `#include <util/check.h>` and remove `<cassert>` across unit test, fuzz, and benchmark files that use assertions. It resolves confusion about whether `NDEBUG` can disable test assertions, prevents build errors when compiling without assertions in `util/check.h`, and facilitates Include-What-You-Use (IWYU) tooling. It also enables `clang-format` in scripted-diff CI verification and sorts modified include lines.

risk.why: Touches only test headers and CI lint script setup; any mistake would be caught at compile time.
